title: Add kernel selection v2 dashboard panels (distribution + latency deltas) w/ cardinality controls
author: Allison Grant
body:
## Summary
Adds Grafana dashboard panels for Kernel Auto-selection v2 rollout monitoring:
- Selection distribution (chosen kernel + selector version) sliced by model family, GPU SKU, and seq-length bucket
- Latency deltas (v2 vs v1) with p50/p95/p99 overlays and error-rate context
- Cardinality controls (topK, label normalization, and aggressive label dropping) to keep queries safe during canary

This is intended to be the primary dashboard referenced during runtime 1.21 canaries and Dedicated pool enablement.

## Why
During early v2 testing we had enough signal to see shifts in kernel choice, but it was hard to correlate selection changes with tail latency regressions by SKU/seq regime without ad-hoc queries. This PR standardizes the panels + templating variables and bakes in guardrails to avoid exploding series count.

## What’s included
### New panels
1) **Selection share (Top kernels)**
- “Chosen kernel (top 10) by requests”
- “Chosen kernel by seq_bucket (short/medium/long/xlong)”
- “Chosen kernel by GPU SKU (normalized)”
- “Selector version share (v1 vs v2) over time”

2) **Latency impact (v2 - v1)**
- “p95 latency delta (ms) by GPU SKU”
- “p99 latency delta (ms) by model family”
- “Latency delta heatmap by (seq_bucket x gpu_sku)”
- “Error rate + fallback rate overlays”

3) **Safety / guardrails panels**
- “Fallback reason rate (missing kernel / denylisted / unstable / guardrail-disabled)”
- “Telemetry sampling rate (expected vs observed)”

### Variables / templating
Adds dashboard-level variables to avoid per-panel hardcoding:
- region
- env (hosted|dedicated|private)
- pool (for Dedicated)
- model (optional; defaults to all)
- model_family
- gpu_sku (normalized)
- seq_bucket
- selector_version

### Cardinality controls
- Default view is aggregate by (model_family, gpu_sku_norm, seq_bucket, kernel_name, selector_version)
- Drops high-card labels where present (e.g., route, build_sha) via recording rule inputs (see below)
- Panels use topk(10) / topk(15) and show “Other” via Grafana transformations where applicable
- A single normalization mapping for GPU SKU strings (A100 variants, MIG, cloud instance suffixes) is applied through label_replace in one shared query helper, not copy/pasted

## Example queries (PromQL)
> Note: metric names follow current runtime telemetry contract; these panels expect the selector to emit `gpu_sku`, `kernel_name`, `seq_bucket`, `model_family`, and `selector_version` labels.

**1) Selection distribution (top 10 kernels) – last 5m**
```
topk(10,
  sum by (kernel_name) (
    rate(runtime_kernel_selection_chosen_total{
      env="$env",
      region=~"$region",
      selector_version=~"$selector_version",
      model_family=~"$model_family",
      seq_bucket=~"$seq_bucket"
    }[5m])
  )
)
```

**2) Selection share by GPU SKU (normalized)**
```
sum by (gpu_sku_norm, kernel_name) (
  rate(runtime_kernel_selection_chosen_total{
    env="$env",
    region=~"$region",
    model_family=~"$model_family"
  }[5m])
)
```
Where `gpu_sku_norm` is derived via:
```
label_replace(gpu_sku, "gpu_sku_norm", "$1", "gpu_sku", "^(A100|H100|L40S).*" )
```
(Full mapping in lib helper; includes MIG and common cloud naming suffixes.)

**3) p99 latency delta (v2 - v1), by gpu_sku_norm**
```
(
  histogram_quantile(0.99,
    sum by (le, gpu_sku_norm) (
      rate(runtime_request_latency_ms_bucket{selector_version="v2", env="$env", region=~"$region"}[5m])
    )
  )
-
  histogram_quantile(0.99,
    sum by (le, gpu_sku_norm) (
      rate(runtime_request_latency_ms_bucket{selector_version="v1", env="$env", region=~"$region"}[5m])
    )
  )
)
```

**4) Fallback reasons rate**
```
sum by (fallback_reason) (
  rate(runtime_kernel_selection_fallback_total{env="$env", region=~"$region"}[5m])
)
```

## Screenshots
- Attached in PR UI: “Selection share (Top kernels)” and “p99 delta by sku” panels (Hosted us-east-1 canary).

## Rollout / compatibility notes
- No runtime changes here; panels will show partial/empty data until ENG-4824 telemetry lands everywhere.
- If `gpu_sku` label is missing in an environment, dashboard falls back to “unknown” bucket.

## Testing
- jsonnetfmt
- dashboard lint
- rendered dashboards validated in local Grafana

## Related
- Linear: ENG-4824 (telemetry fields + sampling), ENG-4826 (rollout gate)
- Runtime 1.21 canary dashboard link will be added to release checklist once merged.
commits: lib: add gpu_sku normalization helper + shared query snippets
dashboards: add latency delta row (v2-v1) with guardrails
dashboards: tighten topK + default filters to prevent high series count
docs: add short panel descriptions + links to runbook section
conversation:
Aisha Bello (review): The latency delta panels look good, but I’m worried about series blowup when people set model=All + gpu_sku=All. Can we hard-cap kernel_name to topk and hide the long tail? Also suggest defaulting selector_version to (v1|v2) not “.*”.

Allison Grant (author): Added topk(10) on the main kernel distribution panels and set selector_version default to /v1|v2/. Also added a note in dashboard description about narrowing filters for Dedicated pools.

Caleb Johnson (review): +1 on cardinality. Also: can we drop `route` and `build_sha` from the latency histogram panels? Some envs still attach those labels and it will make histogram_quantile painful.

Allison Grant (author): Updated queries to use the recording-rule-backed metric variant when present (the `_agg` suffix) and left a fallback path. Also added an explicit `sum by (le, gpu_sku_norm, model_family, selector_version)` so extra labels don’t leak in.

Omar El-Sayed (review): For debugging tail spikes, we need to see fallback reasons alongside latency deltas. Can you add fallback_reason rate as a right-axis overlay or at least in the same row? Also please ensure we’re not graphing request_id anywhere.

Allison Grant (author): Added “Fallback reason rate” and “Fallback %” panels in the same row as p99 delta. Confirmed we never ingest request_id into metrics (only traces). Dashboard uses only bounded labels.

Paula Mendes (review): Minor: panel descriptions should match the telemetry standard language (‘selector_version’, ‘seq_bucket’). Also please add a short blurb about sampling so folks don’t over-interpret low-traffic cells.

Allison Grant (author): Updated panel text + added sampling panel showing observed rate vs expected; also added a tooltip note on heatmap panels.

Aisha Bello (final): Approved after changes. Please link this dashboard from the runtime 1.21 rollout checklist in the next PR.

Merge: Squash merged by Allison Grant after green CI.
release_notes: - Added Kernel Selection v2 rollout dashboard panels (selection distribution, latency deltas, fallback/sampling guardrails) with safe defaults and cardinality controls.
